h1: Orchid Place Hotel Phichit — Clean, Quiet Rooms in the City Center, Easy on the Wallet
intro: Orchid Place Hotel is a small budget hotel in the center of Phichit on Sraluang Road, about 660 m from Bueng Si Fai lake and a 10-minute walk to the town market area · It has 50 rooms, free parking, free Wi-Fi and a simple coffee-and-toast breakfast in the morning · What real guest reviews consistently mention is that the rooms are clean and quiet despite the central location, all from around ฿540/night — making it a solid value pick for anyone visiting Phichit on business or a tight budget.

body.html: Orchid Place is a small hotel in central Phichit that business travelers and budget-minded visitors pick often · The thing real reviews agree on is that the rooms are clean and quiet, even though it sits right in the middle of town — the hotel is on Sraluang Road, just about 660 m from Bueng Si Fai lake and roughly a 10-minute walk to the town market · There's free parking and free Wi-Fi, so it works whether you drive in or arrive by train and take a short ride into town.

Rooms are simple but well equipped · Each has air conditioning, a fridge, a TV, a wardrobe and a coffee/tea set, plus a private bathroom with hot water · With around 50 rooms spread across the building, the place never feels crowded · Many reviews say the beds are comfortable and the rooms cleaner than the price suggests — a good fit for travelers who want a quiet room to rest in after a day of errands.

For breakfast, the hotel serves fresh coffee and toast in the morning · It's not a big buffet, but guests say the coffee is good and it's a fine way to start the day at this price · If you want something more substantial, there are restaurants and cafes within walking distance, including Lark Cafe right nearby · The central location makes finding other meals easy.

"The room was clean and very quiet despite being in the city center · They serve coffee and toast in the morning at a great price · Parking was easy, and it's a short walk to Bueng Si Fai and the market."

To be straight about it, this is a small budget hotel, not a luxury stay · Shared facilities are limited — no pool or gym — and the decor is plain and functional · Some reviews note that a few rooms are on the small side and the styling is basic · If you're hoping for a resort feel or a full set of amenities, this won't be it — but if your brief is a clean, quiet, well-located room for around five hundred baht, it does the job well.

One more thing to plan around: as a small property, the front desk isn't staffed 24 hours like a big hotel · If you arrive late at night, it's best to call ahead with your check-in time · Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is 12:00 · As for getting here, if you're not driving, Phichit train station is not far and a short ride brings you to the hotel in a few minutes.

Overall, Orchid Place scores around 8.0 out of 10 on Trip.com and ranks among the top stays in central Phichit · It's not big or fancy, but its strengths — clean, quiet rooms, a central location near Bueng Si Fai, and a wallet-friendly price — make it a worthwhile pick for business visitors, budget travelers exploring Phichit, or anyone passing through who wants a good room without paying much.

faq.q: Where is Orchid Place Hotel in Phichit, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Orchid Place is at 24/115 Sraluang Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Phichit District, right in the city center · It's about 660 m from Bueng Si Fai, a 10-minute walk to the town market area, and roughly a 6-minute drive from Wat Tha Luang · The central location makes walking around and finding food easy.

faq.q: How much does Orchid Place Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿540/night for a Standard Room · There are larger Superior and Deluxe rooms at roughly ฿650–790 · All rooms have AC, a fridge, a TV and a coffee set · Prices vary by date, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Orchid Place Hotel have parking and Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes to both · Free parking and free Wi-Fi throughout, ideal if you drive in · If you arrive by train, Phichit station is nearby and a short ride brings you to the hotel in a few minutes.

faq.q: What are the rooms at Orchid Place Hotel like — are they clean?
faq.a: Real reviews consistently say the rooms are clean and quiet despite the central location, with comfortable beds · Rooms are simple but well equipped, with AC, a fridge, a TV, a coffee set and a private bathroom · A few rooms are small with plain decor, but they're widely seen as cleaner than the price suggests.

faq.q: Does Orchid Place Hotel serve breakfast?
faq.a: Yes · it's fresh coffee and toast in the morning · It isn't a big buffet, but reviews say the coffee is good and it's just right at this price · For a bigger meal, there are restaurants and cafes within walking distance.

faq.q: Who is Orchid Place Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits business visitors, budget travelers exploring Phichit, or anyone passing through who wants a clean, quiet, centrally located room at a low price · It's a small hotel without resort-style facilities · If you want something larger, consider The Nest Hotel or Phichit Plaza.
